title: Jaa raha hai watan ye luta qafela
body:
SHAH-E-KARBOBALA DUQTAR-E-FATIMA
EK BAHEN TERI EK BETA TERA
<<MINI>>
JAA RAHA HAI WATAN YE LOOTA QAFELA
<<DIVIDER>>
Chodkar Kya Watan Ko Jaye Bahen
Sath Mere Nahi Haye Sheri Suqan
Desaki Na Unhe Bhi Do Gaz Kafan
<<MINI>>
Jaa Raha Hai Watan Ye Loota Qafela
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisi Shadi Huwi Teri Ibne Hassan
Bewa Dulhan Bani Ujdi Ban Mei Dulhan
Para Para Huwa Ran Mei Sime Badan
Lash Kaisi Mili Jane Mushkil Kusha
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Barchi Ka Phal Aarzu Mitgayi
Umme Laila Garib Hath Malti Rahi
Zainab Qasta Dil Dekti Rehgayi
Shah Ka Kadyal Hawa Samne Chal Basa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Wantan Jaungi Chain Kya Paungi
Sughra Pouchegi Jab Kaise Samjaungi
Sath Asghar Nahi Kya main Bataungi
Teer Juhi Laga Muskurakar Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Parcham Haq Utha Daste ghazi Kate
Badh Unke Haram Ban Mei Shahke Lute Phir Haram Pe Sitam Aur Badte Rahe
Qaime Jalne Lage kurte Bhi Jalae Gaye
